payload.title: chef flow releases published:<slot>:<date> marker post-publish — defeats FR-P2-7 duplicate-post gate
payload.symptom: CHEF claims published:chef-<slot>:<VN-date> (task_kind=cowork-slot, ttl_seconds=100800) before send_telegram per FR-P2-7, then calls task_release on the SAME marker in its cleanup path after publishing. Marker is meant to be held ~28h so any re-fire of the slot the same day exits without double-posting. Release re-opens the gate immediately.

occurrences.evidence: marker payload note 're-armed by dispatcher — publisher released marker post-publish (contract drift)' on published:chef-morning:2026-07-02

agent transcript ae05244c94ced7791: task_claim published:chef-evening:2026-07-02 (claimed:true) -> send_telegram market + work (both 'Message sent') -> task_release published:chef-evening:2026-07-02; task_list_held confirmed marker absent at 19:58Z; dispatcher re-armed 20:01Z

payload.recurrence: 2nd occurrence same day — meets recurring-bug 2+ escalation threshold
payload.requested_fix: In chef.md cleanup/finally: release ONLY dispatcher slot tokens / heartbeat locks, NEVER published:<slot>:<date> markers. Marker must expire naturally via TTL. Add explicit DO-NOT-RELEASE note next to the FR-P2-7 claim step. Check other publisher flows (fb-market-poster, digest-predict, news-scout, market-watcher, bctc-analyst) for the same pattern — their 2026-07-02 markers are still held, so today only chef drifts.
payload.workaround_active: dispatcher re-arms marker after RAW-verify (done for both occurrences)
